item.title: Source code of Swedish e-government services has been leaked
item.description:
📝 Subscribe Now Quick Facts Date & Time 2026-03-12 18:25:21 UTC Threat Actor ByteToBreach Victim Country Sweden Industry Government / IT Services Victim Organization CGI Sverige AB Affected Platform Sweden E-Gov Platform Category Source Code Leak Severity Critical Network Open Web Price Free (Source Code) Incident Overview A threat actor going by ByteToBreach has leaked the entire source code of Sweden's E-Government platform, claiming it was obtained through a heavily compromised CGI Sverige AB infrastructure. The actor emphasizes this is the full E-Gov platform source code and not just configuration snippets. The source code is being released for free with multiple backup download links, while citizen databases are sold separately.
🔗 Read more: https://darkwebinformer.com/full-source-code-of-swedens-e-government-platform-leaked-from-compromised-cgi-sverige-infrastructure/
